instruction: Cinematic video still, medium shot from a low angle. Inside a dark boxing gym, the woman in the orange and black athletic top (R1) stands on the left in profile, holding up red boxing mitts. The Asian woman in the white sports bra (R2) stands on the right, facing left, throwing a straight left punch. Her black-gloved hand is fully extended, striking the raised red mitt of the woman in the orange and black top. The background shows red ring ropes and a circular gym logo. Dim overhead lighting creates a cool-toned, athletic atmosphere.
